references.title: K. Matomäki, M. Radziwiłł, X. Shao, T. Tao, J. Teräväinen, Singmaster's conjecture in the interior of Pascal's triangle, Quart. J. Math. 73 (2022) 1137–1177

literature_proposed.summary: Lemma 3.1 of Matomäki–Radziwiłł–Shao–Tao–Teräväinen with ε = 1/20: under the separation hypotheses (3.1) m−m' ≥ exp(log^{2/3+ε} n') or (3.2) m, m', n'−n ≥ exp(log^{2/3+ε} n') (here 2/3+ε = 43/60, the paper's m, m' are k, k'), a scale P obeys (i) m,m',n,n' ≤ exp(log^{3/2−ε/10} P) (3/2 − 1/200 = 299/200), (ii) the dichotomy |am+a'm'+bn+b'n'| ≤ P^j/log^{1000}P or ≥ P^j log^{1000}P for integer coefficients of size ≤ log^{1/100}P, (iii) m−m' ≥ P log^{100}P or m,m',n'−n ≥ P log^{100}P. The paper's "P sufficiently large" is written P ≥ P₂ for t ≥ a₀(P₂); natural numbers j are taken ≥ 1. The proof is elementary: P ranges over powers of two in [exp(log^{2/3+ε/2} n'), exp(2 log^{2/3+ε/2} n')], (i) and (iii) hold for all of them, and a count shows fewer than all fail (ii). Not formalised.

review.words: Is it true that, for every integer $t\geq1$, there is some integer $a$ such that ${n \choose k} = a$ with $1\leq k \le \frac{n}{2}$ has exactly $t$ solutions?

import Mathlib
import Nodes.«variant-3969f1f7--h3--h1--h1--h1».Context

open Nat

/-! Hole `h_scale` of a merged partial proof, as a node (D-12 #5, D-29).
Statement generated by the gate from the assembly; immutable (D-3). -/

theorem variant_3969f1f7__h3__h1__h1__h1 : ∀ (P₂ : ℝ),
  ∃ (a₀ : ℕ),
    ∀ a ≥ a₀,
      ∀ (n k n' k' : ℕ),
        (1 : ℕ) ≤ k' →
          k' < k →
            n < n' →
              (2 : ℕ) * k ≤ n →
                (2 : ℕ) * k' ≤ n' →
                  n.choose k = a →
                    n'.choose k' = a →
                      Real.exp (Real.log (↑n' : ℝ) ^ (43 / 60 : ℝ)) ≤ (↑k : ℝ) - (↑k' : ℝ) ∨
                          Real.exp (Real.log (↑n' : ℝ) ^ (43 / 60 : ℝ)) ≤ (↑k : ℝ) ∧
                            Real.exp (Real.log (↑n' : ℝ) ^ (43 / 60 : ℝ)) ≤ (↑k' : ℝ) ∧
                              Real.exp (Real.log (↑n' : ℝ) ^ (43 / 60 : ℝ)) ≤ (↑n' : ℝ) - (↑n : ℝ) →
                        ∃ (P : ℝ),
                          P₂ ≤ P ∧
                            (1 : ℝ) < P ∧
                              ((↑k : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (Real.log P ^ (299 / 200 : ℝ)) ∧
                                  (↑k' : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (Real.log P ^ (299 / 200 : ℝ)) ∧
                                    (↑n : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (Real.log P ^ (299 / 200 : ℝ)) ∧
                                      (↑n' : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (Real.log P ^ (299 / 200 : ℝ))) ∧
                                (∀ (x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ : ℤ),
                                    |(↑x₁ : ℝ)| ≤ Real.log P ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) →
                                      |(↑x₂ : ℝ)| ≤ Real.log P ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) →
                                        |(↑y₁ : ℝ)| ≤ Real.log P ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) →
                                          |(↑y₂ : ℝ)| ≤ Real.log P ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) →
                                            ∀ (j : ℕ),
                                              (1 : ℕ) ≤ j →
                                                |(↑x₁ : ℝ) * (↑k : ℝ) + (↑x₂ : ℝ) * (↑k' : ℝ) + (↑y₁ : ℝ) * (↑n : ℝ) +
                                                        (↑y₂ : ℝ) * (↑n' : ℝ)| ≤
                                                    P ^ j / Real.log P ^ (1000 : ℕ) ∨
                                                  P ^ j * Real.log P ^ (1000 : ℕ) ≤
                                                    |(↑x₁ : ℝ) * (↑k : ℝ) + (↑x₂ : ℝ) * (↑k' : ℝ) +
                                                          (↑y₁ : ℝ) * (↑n : ℝ) +
                                                        (↑y₂ : ℝ) * (↑n' : ℝ)|) ∧
                                  (P * Real.log P ^ (100 : ℕ) ≤ (↑k : ℝ) - (↑k' : ℝ) ∨
                                    P * Real.log P ^ (100 : ℕ) ≤ (↑k : ℝ) ∧
                                      P * Real.log P ^ (100 : ℕ) ≤ (↑k' : ℝ) ∧
                                        P * Real.log P ^ (100 : ℕ) ≤ (↑n' : ℝ) - (↑n : ℝ)) := by
  sorry
